notes.title: Patch 2024 September 24th
notes.content:
Added Steam trading cards and community items!
Fixed a bug that a bad customer doesn't stop fighting at the end of the day
Fixed a bug that you can assign unreachable big employee
Fixed a bug that causes crash when you a big employee starts working first time after employing

notes.title: Patch 2024 June 28th
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that sometimes cause an error when you override an individual room user
Fixed a bug where user of an individual room doesn't get updated properly
Fixed a bug that if you assign a big employee to a big room while she's in another big room, the graphic remains and sometimes causes an error

notes.title: Patch 2024 June 5th
notes.content:
Made the time speed separated so that you can select it directly
Added the Edit Building option in the home scene, you can edit the building without employees
Fixed bugs that sometimes cause crash while assigning individual rooms or workroom2s to employees
Fixed a bug that sometimes cause crash while deleting building

notes.title: Patch 2024 May 30th
notes.content:
Added tutorial menu at the pause screen
Fixed a bug that when you fire a big employee while they're not in any Big Rooms, the game crashes
Fixed a bug relating cleaning that causes persistent crash

notes.title: Patch 2024 May 29th
notes.content:
Fixed movements of characters around stairs and elevators
Fixed the bug where you can assign multiple Individual Rooms or Workroom2s
Fixed missing tail of Kobolds

notes.title: Patch 2024 May 24th
notes.content:
Added a modes that hygiene recovers itself and hygiene stays at the max, you can change it from the options
You can retrieve materials by deleting rooms now, except gold
Fixed a bug that when a big employee leaves while in a Big Room, sometimes the game crashes
Fixed a bug that where a janitor clean rooms that aren't assigned to them
Fixed the description of Resting Rooms
Raised efficiency of material gathering employees
Added a mention of a way to buy a bigger land in the tutorial

notes.title: Patch 2024 May 23rd
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that when you remove a big worker, sometimes the graphic remain
Fixed a bug where the building info is still visible in the home screen
Fixed a bug where character graphic isn't synced around stairs

notes.title: Patch 2024 May 22nd
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that when you delete Workroom2s or Individual Rooms assigned to employee, the assignment doesn't get deleted
Fixed a bug that when you fire employees from the employee list graphics of employees remain
Fixed a bug that after you fire an big employee in a Big Room, the game crushes
Raised money you can gain from customers slightly
Raised amount of materials you can buy at the Residential Area
Raised efficiency of material gathering employees slightly

Patch2
Fixed a bug that when characters move to stairs or elevators by avoiding occupied rooms, they become inaccessible
